items.titolo: AI causes uproar in mathematics as experts warn against sharing research with LLMs after OpenAI shares 722 manuscripts and proofs
items.descrizione: Last week, OpenAI shared over 400 results for longstanding mathematical formulas that have troubled humans for decades; now researchers say it could take years for humans to validate and prove all the AI-driven work

items.titolo: Excel con Copilot crea report interattivi che si aggiornano da soli
items.descrizione: Microsoft potenzia Excel con Copilot. Report interattivi, automazione delle attività ripetitive e strumenti AI per importare e ripulire i dati. The post Excel con Copilot crea report interattivi che si aggiornano da soli

items.titolo: Use Gemini for free? You’ll soon be limited to its weakest AI model
items.descrizione: Google is cutting off free users from the Flash and Pro models. AI Plus subscribers are losing out too

items.titolo: Anthropic warns of self-replicating AI worm threat that doesn't need data centers to self-improve and spread
items.descrizione: Anthropic’s paper establishes conceptual model capabilities, but doesn’t quite demonstrate a real threat until models improve further.

items.titolo: Reddit user pays $35 for a crypto mining rig left in a garage and gets 54GB of VRAM at 65 cents per GB
items.descrizione: A Reddit user bought a nine-GPU Nvidia P106-100 mining rig with 54GB of VRAM for $35 and ran Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on it locally.
